engine.notes: Denver's improv has consolidated into two theatres, RISE in Ballpark and Chaos Bloom in Baker, after Bovine Metropolis and Impulse went dark. Boulder has a teaching collaborative but no improv stage of its own, and no Aurora improv organisation with a working site was found.

entries.name: RISE Comedy
entries.summary: Denver's largest improv theatre and training center, founded 2011 as the Voodoo Comedy Playhouse, with shows most nights, classes in improv, stand-up, sketch, musical improv, acting and clown up to a 501 level, an open mic and festivals.
entries.schedule: Shows most nights; RISE & Shine open mic weekly; Denver Sketch Festival October 8 to 10, 2026
signals: Theatre of its own at 1260 22nd Street
Improv classes up to 501 plus five other tracks
Shows most nights of the week
RISE Comedy Festival and Denver Sketch Festival
entries.reasons: Fifteen years in one building, a multi-track school, nightly programming and two festivals, with a calendar dated to the day.

entries.name: Chaos Bloom Theater
entries.summary: A bohemian comedy theatre on South Broadway with an annex on Bayaud, teaching five improv levels in six-to-eight-week terms alongside sketch and stand-up, with shows Thursday to Sunday, house team nights and free comedy jams.
entries.schedule: Shows Thursday to Sunday; Level 5 improv Tuesdays October 13 to December 1; sketch Level 1 October 28 to December 9
entries.reasons: A full class ladder, four show nights and free jams in a venue of its own; younger and smaller than RISE, with its founding story in a pandemic alley.

entries.name: The Improv Collaborative
entries.summary: Boulder's longest-running improv community, teaching a nine-week Beginner's Improv Sampler of short-form games and long-form scenes and a ten-week Improvisational Theater course, plus team-building for local companies.
entries.schedule: Beginner's Sampler Mondays September 21 to November 8 and Wednesdays September 23 to November 9
signals: Team-building clients include Google and CU
entries.reasons: Dated fall classes from Boulder's established improv teacher, but no venue, no shows and no advanced ladder.
